title: Cashless decision: one hour
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 15(b), p.23
quote: immediately but not more than one hour of receipt of request.
plain_en: The insurer must decide on a cashless request within 1 hour of receiving it. Ask for the insurer/TPA receipt time.
plain_hi: कैशलेस अनुरोध मिलने के 1 घंटे के अंदर बीमा कंपनी को फैसला करना है। कंपनी या TPA से अनुरोध मिलने का समय लिखित में लें।
caveat: Receipt by the insurer is the stated trigger. A family-entered submission time is evidence supplied by the user, not independent proof. The circular does not separately name enhancement requests.

title: Final discharge authorisation: three hours
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(a), p.23
quote: Insurer shall grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of discharge authorization request from the hospital.
plain_en: Final cashless approval is due within 3 hours after the insurer receives the hospital’s discharge request.
plain_hi: अस्पताल का डिस्चार्ज अनुरोध मिलने के 3 घंटे के अंदर बीमा कंपनी को अंतिम कैशलेस मंजूरी देनी है।

title: Do not keep the patient waiting
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(a), p.23
quote: In no case, the policyholder shall be made to wait to be discharged from the Hospital.
plain_en: The circular says you should not be kept waiting for discharge. Ask the desk and insurer to act now.
plain_hi: परिपत्र कहता है कि पॉलिसीधारक को डिस्चार्ज के लिए इंतजार नहीं कराया जाना चाहिए। अस्पताल और बीमा कंपनी से तुरंत कार्रवाई माँगें।

title: Extra hospital charges after a three-hour delay
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(b), p.23
quote: the additional amount if any charged by the hospital shall be borne by the insurer from shareholder’s fund.
plain_en: If final approval is delayed beyond 3 hours, the insurer must bear any additional hospital charge caused by that delay. Keep the bill and timestamps.
plain_hi: अंतिम मंजूरी में 3 घंटे से ज्यादा देरी हो तो उससे लगे अतिरिक्त अस्पताल शुल्क बीमा कंपनी को देने हैं। बिल और समय का प्रमाण रखें।
caveat: No fixed hourly compensation is created. Link the additional charge to the delay; do not treat every unpaid part of the hospital bill as recoverable under this clause.

title: Immediate help after a death
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 16(c)(i)-(ii), p.23
quote: immediately process the request for claim settlement.
plain_en: If the policyholder dies during treatment, the insurer must process the claim request and arrange release of the body immediately.
plain_hi: इलाज के दौरान पॉलिसीधारक की मृत्यु हो जाए तो बीमा कंपनी को दावा तुरंत प्रोसेस करना है और पार्थिव शरीर तुरंत दिलवाना है।
additional_quote: get the mortal remains (dead body) released from the hospital immediately

title: Insurer/TPA collects hospital documents
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 17(c), p.24
quote: Insurers and Third Party Administrators (TPAs) shall collect the required documents from the Hospitals.
plain_en: After the claim is reported, the insurer/TPA must collect needed documents from the hospital. The policyholder should not have to submit those documents.
plain_hi: दावे की सूचना के बाद बीमा कंपनी या TPA को जरूरी कागज़ अस्पताल से लेने हैं। पॉलिसीधारक से ये कागज़ जमा कराने की माँग नहीं होनी चाहिए।

title: Review before a claim is repudiated
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 17(a), p.23; Protection Circular Part B V.3(iii).4, p.121
quote: No claim shall be repudiated without the approval of PMC
plain_en: A repudiation needs approval by the Product Management Committee or its three-member Claims Review Committee. Ask which body approved it and when.
plain_hi: दावा खारिज करने के लिए Product Management Committee या उसकी तीन सदस्यों वाली Claims Review Committee की मंजूरी चाहिए। पूछें किस समिति ने कब मंजूरी दी।
caveat: The operative sentence names repudiation. Do not assert that every ordinary deduction or partial disallowance necessarily requires CRC approval; ask whether that deduction is being treated as repudiation.

title: Specific policy reasons for deductions
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 17(b), p.24; Protection Circular Part B V.3(iii).5, p.121
quote: giving reference to the specific terms and conditions of the policy document.
plain_en: For a rejected or partly disallowed claim, ask for the full reasons and the exact policy terms for each disputed amount.
plain_hi: दावा खारिज हो या कुछ राशि काटी जाए, तो पूरे कारण और हर विवादित कटौती के लिए पॉलिसी की सटीक शर्त माँगें।

title: Complaint acknowledgement and response
paragraph: Protection of Policyholders’ Interests Master Circular, 5 September 2024, Section 1 Part B VI.2(i), p.123
quote: Insurers should provide resolution to the complaint within 14 days
plain_en: The insurer must acknowledge your complaint immediately and should resolve it within 14 days, with reasons and policy terms if it is not accepted.
plain_hi: बीमा कंपनी को शिकायत मिलते ही उसकी पावती देनी है और 14 दिनों में समाधान देना चाहिए। शिकायत न माने तो कारण और पॉलिसी की शर्त बतानी चाहिए।
caveat: This is the insurer grievance deadline. It is not the separate one-month no-reply prerequisite for the Ombudsman.

title: When you can approach the Ombudsman
paragraph: Council for Insurance Ombudsmen FAQs 8, 9, 10, 11 and 15
quote: You are not satisfied with the response given by Insurance Company/Insurance Broker
plain_en: First complain to the insurer. You may approach the free Ombudsman route after an unsatisfactory/rejected response, or no reply for one month. The claim/compensation limit is ₹50 lakh. Usually file within one year of the rejection/unsatisfactory decision or expiry of that month. The same dispute must not be pending or decided in court, a consumer forum or arbitration.
plain_hi: पहले बीमा कंपनी से शिकायत करें। जवाब से संतुष्ट न हों, शिकायत खारिज हो जाए, या एक महीने तक जवाब न मिले, तो मुफ्त बीमा लोकपाल सेवा में जा सकते हैं। सीमा ₹50 लाख है। आम तौर पर असंतोषजनक फैसले या उस एक महीने के खत्म होने से एक साल के अंदर शिकायत करें। वही मामला अदालत, उपभोक्ता आयोग या मध्यस्थता में लंबित या तय नहीं होना चाहिए।
caveat: One month is a calendar month, not always 30 days. Reminder dates are planning aids, not a calculation of legal limitation. FAQ contains repeated legacy sections; use the updated ₹50 lakh section and formal rules if scope is disputed.

title: Ombudsman award: compliance and delay payment
paragraph: Protection of Policyholders’ Interests Master Circular, 5 September 2024, Part B VI.4(i)-(iv), p.124; Section 2 Chapter VII 25.1-25.4, p.148
quote: a penalty of Rs. 5000/- per day shall be payable to the complainant for each day of delay.
plain_en: The insurer must comply within 30 days of receiving the Ombudsman award. ₹5,000 per delayed day applies, in addition to applicable penal interest, unless the insurer appeals within 30 days and informs you.
plain_hi: लोकपाल का आदेश मिलने के 30 दिनों में बीमा कंपनी को पालन करना है। देरी पर लागू ब्याज के साथ हर दिन ₹5,000 देय हैं; 30 दिनों में अपील करके आपको सूचना देने पर यह प्रावधान लागू नहीं होता।
caveat: Do not present ₹5,000/day as compensation for a hospital discharge delay or as unconditional while a timely appeal is filed.

title: Check the policy before judging room-linked deductions
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter III IV, p.30; Annexure 6 item 19, p.44
quote: This Circular supersedes all the Guidelines/Circulars listed in Annexure-6.
plain_en: Ask for the room limit, the deduction formula and the exact policy clause. A room-related cut to another bill item needs review against your policy and the hospital bill. It is not automatically valid or invalid.
plain_hi: कमरे की सीमा, कटौती का हिसाब और पॉलिसी की सटीक शर्त माँगें। कमरे के कारण अन्य मदों की कटौती पॉलिसी और अस्पताल के बिल से जाँचें। वह अपने-आप सही या गलत नहीं हो जाती।
caveat: 151/06/2020 and the 2020 standardisation master circular are expressly superseded. A blanket 2024 ban on proportionate surgeon/OT/ICU/pharmacy deductions was not established. Historical non-medical item lists are not a universal current coverage rule. Policy/add-on and bundling terms must be checked.

title: You file your own IRDAI complaint
quote: Only complaints from the insured or the claimants shall be entertained.
plain_en: ClaimClock prepares text. You review it and file it yourself with IRDAI. IRDAI’s complaint contacts are 155255, 1800 4254 732 and complaints@irdai.gov.in.
plain_hi: ClaimClock शिकायत का मसौदा बनाता है। आप उसे जाँचकर खुद IRDAI को भेजते हैं। संपर्क: 155255, 1800 4254 732 और complaints@irdai.gov.in।

title: Consumer Commission and the current filing portal
paragraph: Consumer Protection Act 2019, section 69(1)-(2), PDF p.28; e-Jagriti official migration notice
quote: within two years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen.
plain_en: Consumer complaints normally have a 2-year limit from the cause of action; the Commission can allow delay for sufficient cause. The current online filing portal is e-Jagriti, which absorbed e-Daakhil in January 2025.
plain_hi: उपभोक्ता शिकायत आम तौर पर विवाद का कारण पैदा होने से 2 साल में करनी होती है। उचित कारण हो तो आयोग देरी माफ कर सकता है। ऑनलाइन शिकायत अब e-Jagriti पर होती है; e-Daakhil जनवरी 2025 में इसमें शामिल हो गया।
caveat: Cause of action depends on the facts. Do not automatically set the legal deadline at discharge plus two years. Seek advice before choosing parallel forums.

title: Policy-specific room limits, sub-limits, co-pay and deductible
paragraph: Annexure 1 to Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Customer Information Sheet item 8, PDF p.3
quote: The policy will pay only up to the limits specified hereunder
plain_en: The 2024 Customer Information Sheet requires disclosure of policy financial limits, including room/ICU sub-limits, co-payment and deductibles. Verify the actual policy limit and calculation; the form does not impose one universal cap.
plain_hi: 2024 की ग्राहक सूचना शीट में कमरे/ICU की उप-सीमा, सह-भुगतान और डिडक्टिबल सहित पॉलिसी की वित्तीय सीमाएँ बतानी हैं। अपनी पॉलिसी की सीमा और हिसाब जाँचें; यह प्रारूप कोई एक समान सीमा लागू नहीं करता।
caveat: This is the prescribed disclosure format, not a universal room-rent cap or a ban on proportionate deductions. Associated-expense reductions need the actual policy wording and hospital tariff; the 2020 circular was superseded.

title: 60-month moratorium on non-disclosure
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 13, p.22
quote: No policy and claim of health insurance shall be contestable on any grounds of non-disclosure and/or misrepresentation except for established fraud, after the completion of the Moratorium Period, i.e. 60 months of continuous coverage
plain_en: After 60 months (5 years) of continuous coverage, including credits from ported and migrated policies, a policy or claim cannot be contested for non-disclosure or misrepresentation, except for established fraud.
plain_hi: 60 महीने (5 साल) के लगातार कवरेज के बाद, जिसमें पोर्ट और माइग्रेट की गई पॉलिसियों की अवधि भी जुड़ती है, स्थापित धोखाधड़ी को छोड़कर गैर-प्रकटीकरण या गलत जानकारी के आधार पर पॉलिसी या दावे पर आपत्ति नहीं की जा सकती।
caveat: Established fraud remains an exception, and increases in sum insured may have separate continuous-coverage clocks. Keep all renewal and portability records.

title: Claiming across multiple policies (Corporate + Personal)
paragraph: Health Master Circular, 29 May 2024, Chapter I 18(a), p.24
quote: the primary Insurer shall seek the details of other available policies of the policyholder and shall coordinate with other Insurers to ensure settlement of the balance amount as per the policy conditions, without causing any hassles to the policyholder.
plain_en: If you hold more than one health policy (such as corporate plus personal), you may choose which policy to claim under first. If the admissible claim exceeds that policy's cover, the primary insurer must coordinate with your other insurer(s) to settle the balance under policy terms.
plain_hi: यदि आपके पास एक से अधिक स्वास्थ्य पॉलिसी (जैसे ऑफिस और व्यक्तिगत) हैं, तो आप चुन सकते हैं कि पहले किस पॉलिसी में दावा करना है। यदि अनुमन्य राशि उस पॉलिसी के कवर से अधिक है, तो प्राथमिक बीमा कंपनी को शेष राशि के निपटान के लिए दूसरी बीमा कंपनी से समन्वय करना है।
